CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   B. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.

9. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.
   C. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   D. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Study Methods Devotional Method and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Biblical Stewardship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King David and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
